title: The Growing Life Gallery
learning_focus: Age-appropriate reproductive-system identification; animals giving birth or laying eggs; beginnings of life-cycle comparison.
story_premise: A gallery of growth has misplaced diagrams and labels. The player restores scientifically accurate, respectful displays.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Age-appropriate reproductive-system identification; animals giving birth or laying eggs; beginnings of life-cycle comparison.

areas.title: Body Diagram Room
areas.story: Identify the listed male and female reproductive-system parts using age-appropriate diagrams and function labels. Identify common mammal examples.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Science Guide
opening_dialogue.text: The station in Body Diagram Room is not working correctly.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Science Guide
opening_dialogue.text: Identify the listed male and female reproductive-system parts using age-appropriate diagrams and function labels.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Science Guide
opening_dialogue.text: Observe carefully, investigate Age-appropriate reproductive-system identification, record the evidence, and use it to restore the station.
